## The defect

The who-does-what edges lied in two ways (F-521). **Publisher read as
operator:** the EFF Data Driven release and the OSM element set *publish*
lists of cameras — nothing in either evidences that the publisher
*operates* them, yet the emitter/schema path could materialize a publisher
label into an operational role. **Time was fabricated:** the sharing-edge
materializer's undated fallback wrote `1970-01-01` as an edge's lower bound
and observation time — every undated edge read as epoch-asserted — and
there was no vocabulary for "no evidenced date". A missing operator was
implicit absence, never a first-class state (SIG-ONTO-028), and a role
change had no recorded succession — the supersession was neither linked
nor dated.

## What ships

- **Sqitch `role_edges`.** The `entity_role` §C.5 sketch table (zero rows,
  no writer) is reshaped into the real role-edge schema: surrogate
  `entity_role_id` PK (the composite natural PK cannot carry a NULL
  `actor_id`, and `operator_unknown` rows are actor-less by definition),
  `valid_from_kind`/`valid_to_kind` in the closed kind vocabulary extended
  with **`undated`**, `observed_at`, `asserted_by`, `supersedes` self-FK +
  `superseded_by_claim`, `input_digest` (partial UNIQUE — `+0` idempotency),
  `sys_period`. A closed `role` CHECK admits
  `EDGE_ROLE_VOCABULARY` (the 15 `OrganizationRole` values ∪ the §12.4
  role names ∪ `operator_unknown`); `actor_id` is NULL only for
  `operator_unknown`. **Epoch-zero `NOT VALID` CHECKs reject a
  `1970-01-01` bound or observation on both edge tables** — binds new
  writes now; pre-existing rows wait a named VALIDATE follow-up.
  `relationship` gains `supersedes` + the same guards.
- **The one sanctioned temporal mutation.** `close_superseded_entity_roles`
  and `close_superseded_relationships` — SECURITY DEFINER,
  `search_path=pg_catalog` — close open rows' `sys_period` on
  supersession, mirroring `close_superseded_resolutions`.
  `sig_materialize` holds SELECT+INSERT+EXECUTE and **never UPDATE/DELETE/
  TRUNCATE** (asserted in `tests/db/test_materialize_role.py` +
  `test_role_edge_schema.py`); `entity_role` stays off the §37 public
  read surface.
- **`db.organization_roles` taxonomy.** `MAINTAINER` added;
  `SPEC_12_4_ROLES` + `EDGE_ROLE_VOCABULARY` (the SQL CHECK's parity
  source); `UNKNOWN_STATE_FOR_ROLE` (`operator` → `operator_unknown`);
  `ABSENCE_PREDICATES` (`operator_absent` → the operator slot);
  `role_slot()` — `operator` and `operator_unknown` share the `operator`
  slot so absence evidence and operator evidence supersede each other.
  `published_by`/`listed_by`/`published_by_source` map to PUBLISHER —
  provenance, never an entity-ref role.
- **`materialize_role_edges`** (`reconcile.materialize` +
  `sig-reconcile materialize-role-edges`, dry-run default): reads live
  tier-0 claims bearing `object_entity` under an operational-role
  predicate plus `operator_absent` rows; per `(subject, slot)` orders by
  evidenced date (else `sys_period`); within one `claim_lineage.source_id`
  successive distinct states close the prior episode at the later claim's
  date; `revises_claim`/`retraction_of` closes the targeted state
  cross-lineage; open same-state episodes merge across lineages into one
  corroborated edge; **cross-lineage disagreement stays concurrent —
  never silently reconciled**. Undated claims produce an unbounded
  `valid_period` + `valid_from_kind='undated'` — never epoch-zero.
  `read_materialized_role_edges` + `operator_state`
  (operator/operator_unknown/not_asserted) read live rows only.
- **`relationship` supersession + honest undated.** The sharing-edge
  materializer drops the `date(1970,1,1)` fallback; `edge_input_digest`
  covers `observed_at` + bound kinds so a pre-P35.26 1970 row is closed
  as a superseded version when the corrected row lands; stale live rows
  close without deletion; `read_materialized_edges` returns live rows
  only (GQ-15: zero open duplicate edges).
- **Emitter corrections.** EFF Data Driven stamps the release's covered
  window (`valid_from=2016-01-01`/`valid_to=2018-01-01`/`valid_edtf=
  2016/2017`, `exact` kinds — vocab data, not a code constant) plus a
  `published_by` claim per agency ("EFF & MuckRock — Data Driven
  (2018)"). OSM carries the element `timestamp` into
  `observed_at` on every tag claim, dates `operator_absent`, and emits
  `published_by = "OpenStreetMap contributors"` per element.
  `operator_stated`/`operator_qid` stay literal (the operator entity
  crosswalk is the CP-10 row, not this one). Atlas records
  `editingInfo.lastEditDate`/capture `Last-Modified` as
  `upstream_modified_at` provenance — never a `valid_from` guess.
- **`published_by` registered** — `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml`
  (literal, single, GLACIAL/3652d, `max_support`) + regenerated
  `ontology/generated/**` + the `vocab_published_by` sqitch change
  (`vocab_predicate` + the 20-genre `directness_matrix` row,
  `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).
- **ADR-214** records the succession model, the PK reshape, and the
  honest-time decision; indexed (adr README, ADR_TRIGGERS.csv, BL-085,
  spec-src Appendix F). `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry.

- `check_live_claims` corpus 0 violations; `check_spec_src` OK

- **Regression caught + fixed in-flight:** `revert/role_edges.sql`
  dropped the new PK before the dependent `supersedes` FK; the
  materializer cast `subject_id > %s::uuid` and fed raw subjects into
  `ANY(%s::uuid[])` — a non-uuid subject would have aborted the pass;
  the p31_6 access-edge test pinned the pre-change `unknown` kind;
  `test_quality_probe` seeded a literal 1970 edge the CHECK now rejects.
